digest: HEAD 654f639 is not deployable as-is. It renames the public summary field launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries with no alias, widens cancellation matching to 'cancelled' and 'timeout', and changes the stop-poll default from 50ms to 200ms. SPEC.md contradicts all three, and no test covers any of them. Upstream lenses rate the API and state impact high and the security/performance impact low. Validation coverage is none.

risks.note: Breaking public contract: WorkflowTerminalSummary.launchRetryAttempts was renamed to launchRetries with no alias (src/workflow-terminal.ts:33,107). SPEC T3 (SPEC.md:35) names launchRetryAttempts as a public field, so external readers get undefined silently. No in-repo reader exists, so consumers outside the repo are unknown.

Cancellation misclassification: isWorkflowReturnedCancellation (src/workflow-cancellation.ts:20) now accepts 'cancelled' and 'timeout' beyond the SPEC C1 set (aborted, AbortError, ABORT_ERR). Provider timeouts can be recorded as user cancellations, changing retry, terminal status, and summary counts. Real provider payload shapes are unverified.

Spec/code drift with no tests: SPEC S3 says 50ms and a 10ms floor, but code uses 200ms with Math.max(1, ...) (src/workflow-stop.ts:67). SPEC Q1 requires a test per S/C/T item, yet no test files or test script exist. Four drifts (S3, C1, S6, T3) are unguarded.

Unverifiable validation: the only declared check is typecheck, and it is unexecuted. store.js and types.js are missing from the repo, so the stop-intent format and WorkflowRunRecord shape cannot be checked, and typecheck may fail on import.

riskReducers.note: Decide the launchRetries compatibility path: emit both launchRetryAttempts (deprecated) and launchRetries for one release, or revert the rename. Update SPEC T3 to match.
Confirm the real provider payloads that produce 'cancelled'/'timeout'. Drop 'timeout' from the accepted set unless it is verified as a cancel, and update SPEC C1 to match.
Confirm the intended pollMs default (200 vs 50). Update SPEC S3 and the clamp floor to match, or restore 50.

Add contract tests before release: a launchRetries snapshot with no launchRetryAttempts, the exact cancellation marker set, the poll default, and the WorkflowStopRequested error and message. Add a test script to package.json.
Run npm run typecheck and confirm store.js/types.js are present or stubbed. Re-read git diff 11bc671..654f639 -- src/ to confirm the changed-file list, since the upstream diff was not read directly.
